title: Insured Plan of Care Pre-Visit Amount: The Calculation
content:
**Patient financial terms — Insured Plan of Care, payment ahead of a visit.**

**Clause.** The pre-visit amount is the deductible part of the coming visit plus the balance the plan carries, rounded half up to the cent.

- **Expected allowed amount.** The coming visit is expected to be billed with the same timed units as the latest billed visit on the plan, at that visit's allowed amount per unit (its allowed amount divided by its units, taken to four decimal places, rounded half up), and its expected allowed amount is those units times that amount per unit, rounded half up to the cent.
- **Deductible part.** The deductible part is the lowest of the deductible still to be met, the expected allowed amount and the payer program's time-of-service deductible estimate cap, the deductible still to be met being the deductible remaining on file.
- **Balance carried.** The balance the plan carries is the patient balance shown on the plan record.

## Worked example (hypothetical plan on the Commercial High-Deductible Plan of Care, whose deductible estimate cap is $125.00)

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Latest billed visit | 3 timed units, allowed $132.00 |
| Amount per unit | $44.0000 |
| Expected allowed amount | 3 times $44.0000, $132.00 |
| Deductible remaining on file | $500.00 |
| Deductible part | lowest of $500.00, $132.00 and $125.00, so $125.00 |
| Patient balance on the plan record | $40.00 |
| Pre-visit amount | $165.00 |

## Second example (hypothetical plan on a program whose cap is $0.00)

The lowest of the three figures is $0.00, so the deductible part is $0.00 and the pre-visit amount equals the patient balance on the plan record.
